idea.title: Make the canonical draft a clear contract between planning and adaptation
idea.summary: Workflow 03 now defines a format-neutral draft structure, checks the approved brief and source evidence, and stops before platform-specific writing.

context.goal: Make the Post Content Builder workflow actionable while preserving the boundary between canonical meaning and platform adaptations.
context.situation: Workflow 03 described its purpose and output but left its Required Skill section empty and provided no concrete draft headings or brief-readiness stop condition.
context.problem: The instructions did not give a consistent structure for capturing source-supported meaning, uncertainty, and adaptation intent before platform writing.
context.investigation: Reviewed the existing playbook, Content Workflow lifecycle, project writing skills, and current canonical-draft ownership rules.
context.decision: Specify an input gate, a compact canonical-draft outline, source traceability, factual-boundary checks, and explicit format-neutral constraints in Workflow 03.
context.implementation: Updated the Post Content Builder section in framework/content-playbook/Content Creation Playbook.md; removed the empty Required Skill heading because no canonical-writing skill exists in the project skill directory.
context.result: Workflow 03 now gives a bounded process and output structure for writing only content/drafts/post.md, while keeping format and platform adaptation in Workflow 04.

learning_points: A workflow becomes more actionable when its abstract content contract is reflected in a concrete output outline.
A clear readiness gate can prevent content workflows from silently inventing unresolved planning decisions.
Canonical meaning and platform presentation benefit from an explicit stage boundary.
story_points: The workflow already had a sound lifecycle boundary but an empty skill section and no concrete draft structure.
The update made source traceability and uncertainty part of the writing steps.
The output remains one format-neutral canonical file before adaptation begins.
possible_angles: Turning an abstract content workflow into a usable writing contract.
Why a canonical content draft should capture meaning before platform presentation.

resources.description: Short excerpt of the updated Workflow 03 outline and its format-neutral boundary.
